استخدما (form X)

# اُسْتُخْدِمَا (ustuḵdimā) /us.tux.di.maː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
# اِسْتَخْدِمَا (istaḵdimā) /is.tax.di.maː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَخْدَمَ (istaḵdama)
